displayNameNote: Owner supplied Partner Center submission for product AURIX AI, with explicit rejection of the unreserved manifest display name AURIX. Use AURIX AI for package and visual-element display names.
publicationNote: The owner reports that AURIX AI 1.0.2.0 is now live on the Microsoft Store at storeUrl. This repository cannot verify the listing itself; see LISTING-EN.md for the public English copy and screenshots remain an owner-side capture task.
versionRuleNote: Partner Center rejects two packages with the same full name but different contents. 1.0.2.0 is published in the Store; 1.0.3.0 failed certification with error 5001 and is therefore never reused either. The first build that has not been submitted is the only one that should be uploaded. scripts/store.cjs refuses any version listed here or not higher than liveVersion.

canonicalPackage.note: Upload exactly this file to Partner Center. The release is immutable; a later rebuild of the same version is never uploaded, because replacing the file would break this hash.
